# Wills Wing Talon 150

**Prototype:** Wills Wing Talon · **years:** 2001–2005 · **group:** [Topless](/wings/topless/) · **topless**

![Model of the Wills Wing Talon 150 in the game (Blender render)](/docs/models/screenshots/glider_ww_talon/iso45.jpg)

## Data

Numbers are as in the game (`configs/wings/ww_talon.json`). Marks: **passport**, **analog**, **estimate** — [what they mean](/wings/#provenance-marks).

| Parameter | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Span | 10.34 m | **estimate**: from the aspect ratio of the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 and the passport area (3D model spec, section N38) |
| Area | 13.94 m² | **passport**: [willswing.com (archive): talon](https://www.willswing.com/hang-gliders/archive/talon/) “Area (ft²) 150” |
| Wing mass | 34.4 kg | **estimate**: same as the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 (not in the passport) |
| Pilot mass with hang point | 70–105 kg | **estimate**: same as the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 (not in the passport, or the sources contradict) |
| Double surface | 92 % of span | **estimate**: same as the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 (not in the passport) |
| Kingpost | no (topless) | **passport**: quote from the manufacturer's page: [willswing.com](https://www.willswing.com/hang-gliders/archive/talon/) |
| Class / certification | HGMA/USHPA IV Advanced | **passport**: [willswing.com (archive): talon](https://www.willswing.com/hang-gliders/archive/talon/), [willswing.com: placards](https://www.willswing.com/hang-glider-placard-specifications/) |
| Years of production | 2001–2005 | **estimate**: sample of manufacturer pages / certification year (3D model spec, section N38) |
| Trim speed | 38 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0057) |
| Speed, control frame fully pulled in | 100.3 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0057) |
| Stall (straight flight) | 28.7 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0057) |
| Minimum sink | 0.866 m/s at 38 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0057) |
| Glide ratio | 15 at 47.6 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0057); scaling does not change the glide ratio — same as the base |
| Wind at launch | topless, 20–25 m/s | **estimate**: class by crossbar, class limit per the pilot (configs/wing_classes.json); a game menu hint, not used in the physics |
| Reference pilot mass (for the polar) | 85 kg | **estimate**: game model: same place in the range as the base Moyes Litespeed RS 4 |
